status: draft — not yet run against any arm
purpose: Measure the saving that justifies the work. Collected on every run of batteries 1–4, not as separate runs.

metrics.name: instruction tokens loaded at session start
metrics.source: provider token-count endpoint on the exact system prompt + CLAUDE.md + session-start hook output
metrics.note: same endpoint the inventory now uses (inventory meta.tokenMethod)

metrics.name: instruction tokens loaded on demand per session
metrics.source: sum of injected/retrieved sections (A1 loads, A2 hook injections, A4 ranker picks)

metrics.name: total input tokens per session and per task
time to first useful action
metrics.source: transcript timestamps: user message → first tool call that the grader marks useful

metrics.name: retrieval misses
metrics.source: A1/A2/A4: awareness failures where the needed section was never loaded

bar: An arm must save ≥40% of PF-01+PF-02 versus A0 while passing every other battery (plan Section 5), measured, not assumed.

baseline.method: Anthropic POST /v1/messages/count_tokens, model claude-opus-5-5, each block sent as one user message, minus the 8-token message framing (measured by counting "a" minus 1). claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5 and claude-fable-5-1 return the same whole-file count (one tokenizer). Counted 2026-10-26.
baseline.note: CLAUDE.md only; session-start hook output and the system prompt are measured per run by PF-01
